overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for UiB: the fixed heading set is mapped correctly, all seven sections land where the codebook puts them, and learning-outcome sub-groups and arbeidskrav are kept intact in the 11 normal plans. Remaining issues are a heading-only plan emitted as content, exam-semester fragments appended to assessment, and small recommended/required prerequisite mixing.

findings.description: The source page held only the list of field headings with no body text. The extractor emitted a course_content row consisting of the heading labels (flagged blob/leak, 434 chars). These are not course content; the correct result is no sections at all. The pre-pass flags are real, although the cause is an empty page rather than a splitter failure.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: When the page has headings but no bodies, the reader/text fallback in R/blocks.R or sectionize() treats the label lines after the first 'Mål og innhold' heading as content, because no non-empty body exists to cut at.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (R/extract_sections.R) drop a section whose text consists solely of lines that match known UiB heading labels (the heading map patterns), so heading-only pages yield zero rows. Also consider flagging such plans as empty at the fulltext level.

findings.evidence: Haust. Der er òg vurdering tidleg i vårsemesteret for studentar med gyldig godkjenning av obligatoriske arbeidskrav.
findings.description: The 'Vurderingssemester' heading is mapped to assessment, so exam-timing logistics (which semester, re-sit early in the next semester) are appended to the assessment text. The text is exam logistics, not assessment form. The leading 'Haust.'/'Vår.' also does not occur in the plan text shown (which reads '. Der er òg ...'), so it appears to be re-injected from structured page data, in some cases contradicting the course semester label (FRAN313L autumn 2022 gets 'Vår.').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps 'Vurderingssemester' to assessment instead of .drop or an unmapped label; a semester word is added by a reader/cleanup step.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Vurderingssemester' to .drop in R/section_heading_map.R (like 'Hjelpemiddel til eksamen'), and check where the semester word is added to the text.

findings.evidence: NB. Studentane får 1 time teknisk tilleggstid, slik at dei har 7 timar på å utforma svaret.
findings.description: In the covid-addendum paragraphs, the extractor output drops sentences that exist in the plan (the replacement of the oral exam by a 6-hour written exam in assessment, and the 'ingen obligatorisk frammøte' sentence in coursework_requirements). The remaining NB sentence is left without context. Likely a cleanup step removed sentences containing 'korona' / the anonymizer.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: A pattern in anonymize_text()/.clean_sections() deleting sentences mentioning the coronavirus or a date-like token; the plan shows the gap as 'NB.  er munnleg eksamen'.
findings.suggested_fix: Check which pattern removes the 'koronasituasjonen'/'koronavirus' sentences and restrict it to page-noise rather than course-plan text.

findings.description: Required ('Krav til forkunnskaper') and recommended ('Anbefalte forkunnskaper') text are concatenated, and placeholders ('Ingen', '-') are kept in front of the real content. The pre-pass 'empty' flag is a false alarm (14 chars but real content), though the placeholder is noise and recommended vs required cannot be told apart.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Both headings map to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R; .clean_sections() does not strip lone placeholder lines when other text follows.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip block lines that are only 'Ingen'/'-'/'Ikkje relevant' when combining multiple blocks for the same section; optionally keep the heading label ('Anbefalte forkunnskaper:') as a prefix.
